messages:
Aria: Heads-up — scheduling infra apply in release quiet window tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Patch: route table replace + IAM assume-role principal change. Planning staged rollout: staging canary -> prod regions. Thoughts? :wave:
Tom: No blockers from infra. Please pin providers and include a tfstate snapshot + revert playbook. Keep staging canary to 1 AZ, 15m soak.
Jules: Addable: we should create a focused smoke job that exercises cross-account assume-role and an egress path test. If smoke fails, rollback immediately. I'll own validation.
deploybot: change window reserved by @Aria for 2026-04-12 02:00 UTC — no overlapping deploys allowed. Required checks: tf fmt, tf validate, plan approval. Reminder scheduled 30m before window.
infra-bot: terraform plan (detached) complete — summary: adds=9 changes=2 deletes=0. Notable: route replace for prod, iam principal update. Plan URL: https://ci.internal/plans/2016004321
Aria: Provider pin proposal (root module):
```hcl
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 4.80"
    }
  }
}
```
Tom: Good. Also freeze module versions that depend on provider if possible. I'll add a CI gate to block merges without the pin.
Jules: Smoke script (short):
```bash
# smoke-canary.sh
curl -sfS https://staging.api.internal/health || exit 1
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/canary-smoke --role-session-name smoke
# quick egress check
ping -c 3 8.8.8.8 || exit 2
```
Aria: Rollback criteria: 1) 5xx rate >0.5% sustained 10m OR 2) p95 latency increase >35% over baseline for 10m OR 3) any failed canary assume-role. If triggered: oncall executes revert plan (restore tfstate snapshot + targeted apply). Prepare revert job now.
infra-bot: tfstate snapshot created: s3://redwood-backups/2026-04-12/release-2016004321.tfstate.gz
Tom: Revert playbook (short): 1) Lock merges, 2) run `terraform init` with previous backend config, 3) `terraform state pull > prev.tfstate`, 4) `terraform state push prev.tfstate` (only if needed), 5) `terraform apply -auto-approve` using revert plan. I'll add full steps to runbook.
Aria: Owners: Aria = release owner + runbook, Jules = canary validation, Tom = provider pin + revert playbook, oncall = rollback executor. We'll keep per-region apply windows to 20m and move slowly after staging.
release-cookbook: Release notes draft created: https://docs.internal/releases/2026-04-12 — include note about IAM principal change and expected route propagation during window.
Jules: I'll post the final smoke script + dashboard links before EOD. :+1: 
Aria: Great, locking merges 30m before window. Thanks all. :lock:
deploybot: Reminder scheduled 30m before window start.
